scope: Supplied-byte manifests, bounded read-only analytical/dissent plans, attributed outputs, typed relations, non-authorizing reconciliation, ordered resumable events and finding-bound remediation evidence coverage.
hypothesis: Explicit bindings and retained dissent permit reproducible local review without creating a second memory or authority system.
schema_identity: codex.review.v1; implemented kinds: manifest, plan, lane-output, history, recommendation. No other review kinds or versions are supported.
validation_boundary: The installed contract identifies review envelope kinds; SDK entry points enforce their strict semantic fields and bindings. At import core.record validates a Draft exemplar. Pure review calls copy that restricted envelope and validate its integrity without file access. attach_continuation is the existing-storage adapter and may read the installed core contract resource.
acceptance: Reject candidate/context drift, malformed plans, unsafe tools and mixed outputs
Retain original wording, unverified source attribution and unresolved conflict
Reject event reorder/duplicates and stale caches
Resume pending requirement only with exact current binding and explicit clearance
rollback: Remove new review attachments in a newly previewed continuation successor; preserve original history and user-owned bytes. No activation, destructive migration or automatic rollback execution.
event_trust: UUIDv4 event IDs differ from content IDs. Coordinator guarantees cross-store uniqueness. Ordered digests detect accidental changes only; an attacker can rewrite and reseal a complete history. Not tamperproof, authenticated or independently witnessed.
operational_separation: Coordinator is implementer. Roles and rotated same-platform fixture actors are unverified, not evidence of independent execution.
resource_disclosure: Bounded Repository-Internal Draft records; existing Unknown/Secret export denial unchanged.
unsupported: External evidence eligibility and assurance DAG (planned)
